goals: Normalize local UTF-8 text files and save normalized output

functional_requirements.statement: Read a user-provided local UTF-8 text file
Write normalized text to a requested destination

quality_requirements.statement: Report input/output errors clearly without silently losing the original file

components.name: Text normalization CLI utility
components.responsibility: Coordinate the application capabilities and system-wide requirements

interfaces.name: system_entry
interfaces.failure_behavior: Return an explicit error; no silent success

components.data_not_applicable_reason: Application state is owned by designated child components
validation_evidence: Curated architecture fixture identifies the entry boundary, responsibility and component allocation
components.stop_reason: System-level decomposition and child boundaries are represented by the fixture

components.name: Input Reader

interfaces.name: input_contract
interfaces.failure_behavior: Return an explicit error; no silent success

quality_targets.NFR-001: Report read/decoding errors; never mutate source on read

validation_evidence: Curated fixture documents responsibility, interface and data boundary for input
components.stop_reason: Further decomposition of input is not required for this sample scope

components.name: Text Normalizer

interfaces.name: normalize_contract
interfaces.failure_behavior: Return an explicit error; no silent success

components.data_not_applicable_reason: Text Normalizer is stateless or delegates persistence to an owning component
validation_evidence: Curated fixture documents responsibility, interface and data boundary for normalize
components.stop_reason: Further decomposition of normalize is not required for this sample scope

components.name: Output Writer
components.responsibility: Persist normalized text with failure handling

interfaces.name: output_contract
interfaces.failure_behavior: Return an explicit error; no silent success

quality_targets.NFR-001: Preserve original content on failed writes; report errors

validation_evidence: Curated fixture documents responsibility, interface and data boundary for output
components.stop_reason: Further decomposition of output is not required for this sample scope

verification_cases.description: Review input read and decoding failure contract
Review atomic write and preservation design

decisions.title: Single-process modular CLI
decisions.choice: Single process with three cohesive modules
decisions.rationale: Local processing requires no distributed communication

findings.description: Atomic replacement semantics need implementation review
